store.ai_overview: Based on customer reviews, BrandsMart USA shines for its competitive prices and a wide product selection. Yet, their customer service, reliability, website design, and returns policies require improvement.

top_reviews.text: The sales person and the manager were exceptional on their ability to price match , and provide a quick purchase experience , thanks !

Honestly, I had never heard of BrandsMart before, but they had the best price on the containers I wanted, so decided to take a chance haha.
For some unknown reason, they even included $15 off my purchase AND free shipping also.
I was pleasantly surprised to receive my order in a timely manner and am very happy with the company and my containers!
Ordering was simple, delivery was excellent. The only issue was that the list of required items for installation was incomplete. Fortunately I caught the issue and was able to handle

reviews.text:
I recently purchased a washer and dryer from BrandSmart and scheduled delivery for Saturday, June 6, 2026. The delivery date was clearly listed on my receipt, and I specifically chose a Saturday because I work during the week and cannot sit home all day waiting for a delivery.

When I had not received a delivery call by Saturday morning, I contacted BrandSmart around 10:30 a.m. The representative who answered was extremely rude and immediately told me that I was scheduled for Monday, June 9, not Saturday. This came as a complete surprise since my receipt clearly showed June 6 as the delivery date.

I explained that a weekday delivery would be difficult because I work and needed to know whether I would have enough time to make arrangements with my employer. I repeatedly asked a simple question: what are the general delivery hours? I understood that my specific delivery window would not be known until I received a call, but I wanted to know the overall delivery timeframe so I could plan accordingly.

Instead of answering my question, the representative repeatedly insisted that I was not understanding her. Ironically, she was not understanding my question. The conversation became increasingly frustrating, and eventually the call was disconnected. She never called back, never acknowledged my concerns, and showed very little professionalism or customer service.

Fortunately, my sales representative, who was actually on vacation, responded immediately when I texted her. She contacted her manager and discovered that someone had apparently changed the delivery date. She also informed me that delivery dates should not be changed without the customer's consent, and she had certainly not made any changes herself since she was on vacation.

In the end, I did receive the delivery and was able to make it to work on time. However, that does not change the fact that my delivery date was altered without my knowledge, I was given conflicting information, and I was treated poorly when

Don't order anything online; you can't specify which cable you need for the electrical appliance. In my case, I bought a dryer, and it's been a nightmare. I had to go in person to buy a different cable and return the one that came with the delivery. Then, the dryer wasn't working correctly; it wasn't drying properly. I had to go back to the store so that the customer service department could call me to schedule an appointment. The customer service is terribly bad, as I have to wait more than a week for a diagnostic visit, and without that visit, I can't return the dryer.
And that's only if they even agree to exchange it.

Here's my experience 

It has been over a month since I bought a refrigerator, and to this day, it has not been delivered correctly. Two delivery attempts were made, and both times the wrong size refrigerator was brought.
During the first delivery attempt, the delivery personnel brought a refrigerator that was far larger than what I ordered. Without explaining anything to me, one of the men removed my front door entirely-even though the refrigerator could not fit through it. At no point was I informed of what he intended to do, nor did he measure the door or the refrigerator before removing my door. Watching a complete stranger take off my front door and carry it outside without my consent was shocking and deeply upsetting. That experience has stayed with me since and still hurts each time I remember the scene.
BrandsMart's customer service has been extremely poor. Phone calls go unanswered for long periods, and when someone finally responds, the staff are rude and unprofessional. Unfortunately, my salesperson was also rude and dismissive.

All I am asking is simple: deliver the refrigerator I paid for, correctly and professionally, please.

#sweepstakes 

The 3 biggest problems with BrandsMart (and there are far more) are:  1.  You have to wait to find a salesman. . . for appliances, this can take awhile.  2.  All of their rebate programs suck.  You will have to spend days of your time copying receipts, finding serial numbers, waiting for a check in the mail and navigating their website . . . where you will never get anyone live to talk to.  3.  The BrandsMart that I went to didn't even have the appliances that I wanted to purchase!  We had to drive 10 miles away to a warehouse so that we could pick them up.  So I ended up wasting a lot of time driving back and forth. 4. (and this is a bonus), one of the cords that I bought was too short so when I tried to return it, they gave me a gift card to the store (after not wanting to take it back to begin with).  NO BrandsMart, if I return a cord WITH A RECIEPT and it is same day. . . you give me my money back!

I was impressed with the selection of the furniture of what we were looking for. There was name brand and brands I've never heard of, but still seemed to be of great quality. Our salesman Corderrell was the highlight of our experience!! From the get-go, he was more than willing to help us, and was very patient with all the questions my wife and I threw at him. In the end, we ended up with a great deal on our couch and loveseat, and have been back a few times since then.
